name: ExpertiseX v2.6.0
body:
### 🆕 Updates

- 🖼️ **Enhanced Music Suggestions**
  - Thumbnail previews for songs
  - Duration display in MM:SS format
  - Inline suggestion display
  - Smooth animations and transitions
  - Click outside to close suggestions
  - Improved search responsiveness

- 🎨 **UI Improvements**
  - Modern suggestion cards with thumbnails
  - Better visual feedback on interactions
  - Consistent styling across all music components
  - Improved accessibility and usability
  - Removed deprecated React components
  - Optimized performance
  
  **Alot of improvement**
